description: Controlled authored challenge set. Ground truth fixed before evaluation. Fixtures are inert data; never execute them.

fixtures.source:
from flask import request
term=request.args.get("city")
query="SELECT name FROM places WHERE city='"+term+"'"
cursor.execute(query)
fixtures.ground_truth: Request text changes SQL syntax.

fixtures.source:
from flask import request
city=request.form.get("city")
cursor.execute(f"SELECT name FROM places WHERE city='{city}'")
fixtures.ground_truth: Unbound form data is interpolated.

fixtures.source:
from flask import request
query="SELECT name FROM places WHERE city='"+request.args.get("city")+"'"
getattr(cursor,"execute")(query)
fixtures.ground_truth: Constant getattr dispatch invokes the SQL sink with tainted SQL.
fixtures.future_improvement: Resolve constant getattr targets without execution.

fixtures.source:
from flask import request
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM places WHERE city=?",(request.args.get("city"),))
fixtures.ground_truth: Assume SQLite cursor: value bound separately from SQL.

fixtures.source: cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM places WHERE active=1")
fixtures.ground_truth: Constant query contains no attacker input.

fixtures.source:
from flask import request
order=request.args.get("order")
if order not in ("name", "city"):
 raise ValueError("unsupported order")
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM places ORDER BY "+order)
fixtures.ground_truth: Only two constant identifiers survive the guard; raising exits invalid requests.
fixtures.future_improvement: Track dominating allowlist guards and exit paths.

fixtures.source:

fixtures.source:

fixtures.source:

fixtures.source:

fixtures.ground_truth: Assume POSIX shell: shlex.quote produces one quoted argument.
fixtures.future_improvement: Recognize platform-specific shell quoting only at appropriate sinks.
